installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Script d'installation Python v5 (Pelican Native)
set -e

apt update -q
apt install -y -q git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ libtool tar xz-utils

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${INSTALL_FFMPEG}" == "1" ] || [ "${INSTALL_FFMPEG}" == "true" ]; then
    echo "[FFMPEG] Installation de FFmpeg (Build Statique)..."
    if [ ! -f "./ffmpeg" ] || [ ! -s "./ffmpeg" ]; then
        curl -sL https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/releases/ffmpeg-release-amd64-static.tar.xz -o ffmpeg.tar.xz
        tar -xf ffmpeg.tar.xz --wildcards --strip-components=1 '*/ffmpeg' '*/ffprobe'
        rm -f ffmpeg.tar.xz
        chmod +x ffmpeg ffprobe
        echo "[INFO] FFmpeg et FFprobe installes dans /mnt/server."
    else
        echo "[INFO] FFmpeg est deja present."
    fi
fi

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo "[INFO] Mode User Upload active. Clonage Git ignore."
    exit 0
fi

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo "[WARN] Aucune adresse Git fournie. Mode manuel."
    exit 0
fi

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"
fi

if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    CLEAN_URL=$(echo "${GIT_ADDRESS}" | sed -E 's#^https?://##')
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@${CLEAN_URL}"
fi

if [ -d .git ]; then
    git pull || echo "[WARN] Echec du pull Git."
else
    if [ -z "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
        if [ -n "${BRANCH}" ]; then
            git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
        else
            git clone "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
        fi
    else
        git init
        git remote add origin "${GIT_ADDRESS}"
        git fetch origin
        TARGET_BRANCH="${BRANCH:-main}"
        git reset --mixed "origin/${TARGET_BRANCH}" || git reset --mixed "origin/master" || true
    fi
fi

if [ -n "${SYSTEM_PACKAGES}" ]; then
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/.apt
    cd /mnt/server/.apt
    rm -f *.deb
    for pkg in ${SYSTEM_PACKAGES}; do
        apt-get download -q "$pkg" || echo "[WARN] Impossible de telecharger $pkg"
    done
    if ls *.deb 1> /dev/null 2>&1; then
        for deb in *.deb; do dpkg -x "$deb" .; done
        rm -f *.deb
    fi
    cd /mnt/server
fi

echo "[INFO] Installation terminee."
exit 0
